name: Six GPUs on one x16 slot

mentions.name: Six GPUs on one x16 slot
mentions.description: A DIY hardware build assembling six consumer GPUs to run off a single PCIe x16 slot, piecing together off-the-shelf parts into a high-performance machine.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’ve been fooling around with a lot of consumer GPU hardware and having a fun time. There are so many rabbit holes and interesting parts available to piece a Rube Goldberg of a performant clanker together.

https://doug.sh/posts/six-gpus-one-x16-slot/
